structural_approach: Open on the tool itself to spark curiosity, show a quick before/after demonstration of turning a reference structure into an editable clip, highlight that the result stays editable, then close with a warm human-facing call to action.

mechanism_dispositions.application_rationale: Section 1 opens on a still, centered shot of the app interface with a small hand gesture (tapping to start), mirroring the reference's object-first hook without narration or action.

Section 2 sequences a close-up of the raw reference-video timeline being broken into structure, then a shot of the new clip assembling, implying quality and payoff before any spokesperson appears, as in sections 2-3 of the reference.

Sections 3-4 shift from screen-focused demonstration to a small-business owner facing the camera, carrying the warm, trust-oriented close and the CTA, matching the reference's object-to-person transition.

sections.section_purpose: Spark curiosity with a clean first look at the tool rather than opening on narration or action.
sections.content_instruction: Show a static, centered view of the app's home screen with a hand about to tap an upload button, implying imminent use without explaining it yet.
required_information: to be supplied: actual app interface screenshot or mockup
sections.visual_direction: Tight, still framing on the screen with the hand entering from one side; no motion blur or fast cuts.
sections.text_direction: Minimal or no on-screen text; if used, a short phrase naming the tool only.
sections.speech_direction: None or a single brief line setting up curiosity about what happens next.
sections.pacing_direction: Single shot, no cuts, calm pace.
sections.transition_direction: Hard cut into section 2 as the tap registers.

sections.section_purpose: Demonstrate the transformation from a reference video's structure into a new draft clip.
sections.content_instruction: Cut from a close-up of a reference video's timeline being segmented into labeled blocks to a shot of a new clip forming in the same structure with the business's own footage.
required_information: to be supplied: sample reference video and sample business footage for the demo
sections.visual_direction: Close-up on segmented timeline markers, then a wider shot of the new draft assembling on screen; use light and motion cues (progress bar filling) to suggest momentum.
sections.text_direction: Short on-screen labels such as segment markers, no claims.
sections.speech_direction: Brief explanatory line describing the structure being reused, kept factual and non-promissory.
sections.pacing_direction: One cut between the two shots, slightly quicker pace than section 1.
sections.transition_direction: Cut to section 3 as the draft clip finishes forming.
limitations: Actual segmentation UI behavior not supplied.

sections.section_purpose: Establish that the finished draft is not locked, reassuring time-poor owners they retain control.
sections.content_instruction: Transition from the screen to a small-business owner on camera, shown making a simple edit (swapping text or a clip) on the just-built draft to prove it remains adjustable.
required_information: to be supplied: a representative small-business owner or presenter
sections.visual_direction: Medium shot of a person at a desk or counter interacting naturally with the app, warm lighting, relaxed body language.
sections.text_direction: On-screen text confirming the clip can still be changed, phrased descriptively, not as a guarantee.
sections.speech_direction: Warm, confident line noting the draft can still be adjusted to fit their own post.
sections.pacing_direction: Single shot, unhurried, slightly slower than section 2 to signal reassurance.
sections.transition_direction: Cut to section 4 as the person looks up toward camera.
limitations: No supplied footage of an actual user; description assumes a representative owner.

sections.section_purpose: Close with a direct, low-pressure invitation to try the tool on their next post.
sections.content_instruction: Hold on the same person facing the camera, inviting the viewer to try the tool for their own next post, without promising results or pricing.
required_information: to be supplied: final CTA wording and any on-screen brand mark
sections.visual_direction: Close-up on the presenter's face and upper body, steady framing, confident but unforced expression.
sections.text_direction: Short on-screen prompt reinforcing the spoken invitation, avoiding any performance or price claims.
sections.speech_direction: Direct, warm line inviting the viewer to try the tool for their next post.
sections.pacing_direction: Single held shot, calm close pace matching section 3.
sections.cta_direction: Invite the viewer to try the tool for their next social post, framed as an easy next step rather than a promise of results.
limitations: Exact CTA wording and brand display not supplied.
No actual app footage, presenter, or sample videos were supplied; visual directions describe intended content only.
Reference speech and emotional intent were only loosely established, so emotional/CTA pacing is adapted rather than copied.
